title: Host document
description: What GET https://{host}/.well-known/registry.json returns when the host serves several roots rather than being one. Told apart from a registry document by kind. Lists the roots the caller may see; an anonymous caller sees the public subset. File spec section 8.

kind.description: Required here. The two well-known documents are told apart by this field, and only the registry document may omit it.

auth.description: How to authenticate to the host. One token covers every root on the host that the token grants.

roots.description: The roots this caller may see, inline. A caller with a token sees the roots that token grants; the anonymous list is a subset of it.

roots_url.description: Where the roots are paged instead of being listed inline. Its response is a roots page.

slug.description: The root's slug, equal to that root's registry.json slug. It is the root's path prefix on this host.

url.description: The root, without a trailing slash. GET {url}/registry.json MUST return a registry document.

role.description: The caller's role on this root, when the host chooses to disclose it.
